assumptions.assumption: The game client presents a non-web interface because it is described as a player game client rather than a web application.
assumptions.basis: The source describes players running and playing through a game client on their own machines.

assumptions.assumption: The lobby is internet-facing because players must be able to reach it from wherever they are and the source says it is exposed.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the lobby is reachable from wherever a player is and that the exposed client-facing services are in the production network.

assumptions.assumption: The game servers are internet-facing because players must be able to reach them from wherever they are and the source says they are exposed.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the game servers are reachable from wherever a player is and that the exposed client-facing services are in the production network.
